column3: ObjList::count: the deque's size word, members counted not resolved; prose at m_count
Query::count: Refresh, accessor, size; invalid receiver prints and answers 0; evaluation itself is the query system's
free Count(player, class): reads a per-player class-name counter map (0x004441e0/0x00444030) whose maintenance was not traced; engine counts live is-a objects
GAIKA::Count/6: walk matches census_of<true>; gaps named in squad.cpp: GAIKA node table approximated (design), 0x0044eb80 fog-memory rewrite absent, settlement sentry tail (0x00420c00) left out
GAIKA::Count/3: walk matches count_class_in_node; same node-table and 0x0044eb80 gaps; sentry tail gated on ready count only, not BaseTownhall (0x0043ffc0) plus strength > 0
ItemHolder::count: vtbl+0x104 of the holder, not resolved; no shipped site reaches it, and m_count refuses an ItemHolder receiver
Squad::Count: is-a by name over the squad's members; comma-list acceptance labelled (no shipped site)
ClearDead: unresolvable or vtbl+0x50 (IsDead) members erased in place; same rule as m_is_dead
GetObjList: Refresh then ordered copy (0x00438230); invalid receiver is a fresh empty list
ObjList::Add: FIXED -- dedup by handle (0x0050e2a0) and no validity test; test objlist_add_appends_once_and_takes_the_handle_as_it_stands
SquadList::Add: FIXED -- plain append, no dedup (0x00437870 -> 0x00435d90); test squadlist_add_goes_through_the_objlist_domain

Hero::army: a live alias of the hero's army ([hero+0x1cc], HeroRecord::army) through the pool's second alias seam, installed by HeroSystem::start -- FIXED: snapshotted (query-model round); test a_heros_army_comes_back_as_a_list_in_attach_order; an invalid receiver is a fresh empty list
Obj::Clear: writes the invalid handle through a by-reference receiver; prose corrected from "writes into the object"
ObjList::Clear: empties the deque (0x006a3cc0), handle kept
AddList: FIXED -- ordered union, push only when absent; test objlist_addlist_and_removelist_are_set_moves_not_copies
Remove: FIXED -- first occurrence only (0x0041ee70), diagnostic when absent; test objlist_remove_and_removelist_take_one_occurrence_per_handle

RemoveList: FIXED -- one first-occurrence erase per member of the argument; test objlist_remove_and_removelist_take_one_occurrence_per_handle. Gap: RemoveList(self) walks the list it erases in the original (no shipped site)
GetUnitsOnBoard: copy of the ship holder's deque; engine answers id order since a ship holder keeps no roster here (differs after unload/reload)
NearestObj (point): 10,000,000 start, strict less, edge distance 0x005a7900
NearestObj (object): as point form less the argument's radius (0x005a77b0); invalid argument answers invalid
ObjList::Contains: handle scan, argument not resolved
Query::Contains: FIXED -- Refresh then handle scan (0x00571870); was refused, trapping the tutorial; test objlist_contains_on_a_query_asks_the_refreshed_result

FilterClosest: FIXED -- bounded heap (0x00561450, comparator 0x0055df20, sift 0x0055eb40); ties keep the earlier member; test objlist_filterclosest_is_a_bounded_heap_whose_ties_keep_the_earlier_member
IdxToSet: slot table with holes reused first-free (0x005c3a80); engine never despawns a settlement so equal; load-time numbering not read

GetUnitsInSameHolder: FIXED -- a settlement holder's roster in garrison order (same deque as Settlement::Units); test objlist_get_units_in_same_holder_follows_the_holders_own_roster. Other holders fall back to id order
MaxSetIdx: slot-table length, nulls included; see IdxToSet
ObjClass: lookup 0x00409e40, is-a 0x0059a220; unknown name answers empty
ObjEnemy: owner's relation bit 0 clear for the player record at player-1
ObjAlly: complement of ObjEnemy's bit test
ObjInjured: FIXED -- per-object maximum (+0xc8, object_max_health) not the class's; test objlist_obj_injured_measures_against_the_objects_own_maximum

Sleep: two-phase suspend, wait stored for the runner, re-armed at clock + wait (0x00688220); scheduler order FIXED to the wheel's arming order (0x00688060/0x006879a0), test vs_scripts_due_together_run_in_the_order_they_were_armed. Interpreter's 15,000-instruction yield is a separate VM gap, noted
AIBreakScript: stops the caller-player's thread id 3..51 (0x0041cdc0/0x0069fee0); engine kills by global script id. Design: AIRun handles are per-AI-player recycled ids the scheduler does not keep
AIBreakScript(player, handle): as 0x00421cd0 with the player explicit; not bound, no shipped site
AIRun(name): FIXED failure answers -1 (test vs_a_missing_script_is_survivable). Gap: per-player recycled handle 3..51 (design) and the caller's AI-player tag not checked
AIRun(name, set, ol, obj, n): as 0x00422f90; binds four parameters; same handle gap
AIRun(player, name, ...): read; not bound (engine binds free arity <= 5); no shipped site
Conversation::Run: original polls with 1 ms suspends until finished, then deletes and clears the variable; engine plays inside the call (documented design in conversation.cpp)
Run(name): FIXED -- compile and run synchronously (0x006a0360), was a spawned peer; test vs_run_calls_the_script_to_its_end_and_answers_nothing
Run(name, i1): FIXED -- bound, synchronous, integers as parameters (same test shape)
Run(name, i1, i2): FIXED -- bound, synchronous; no shipped site
Run(name, i1..i3): FIXED -- bound, synchronous; no shipped site
Run(name, i1..i4): FIXED -- bound, synchronous; no shipped site
Run(name, i1..i5): FIXED -- bound, synchronous; no shipped site
Settlement::Run(set, name): FIXED -- bound as member Run/1, synchronous with the settlement as parameter; no shipped site
KillScript: answers status 2, the interpreter stops the calling thread; Scheduler::kill on the caller
StartPlayerScript: FIXED -- eight name slots per player (0x0056f720), a second start of a name refused, slots saved; test vs_start_player_script_starts_a_name_once_per_player
AreaCenter: first member of the named group; circle centre or truncated rectangle midpoints; (-1,-1) on a miss

ClassPlayerAreaObjs: FIXED -- player outside 1..16 and a name that is no class answer the invalid query, before the area; test an_area_query_with_no_such_class_or_player_is_an_invalid_handle. The query (0x004fe730) is the query system's

AttackArea ("advance" into 0x0057a2e0): FIXED -- dead members skipped before their draw, invalid query a message; tests attack_area_passes_over_a_dead_member_before_its_draw, attack_area_on_an_invalid_query_orders_nothing_and_does_not_trap
AreaObjs: FIXED -- a name that is no class answers the invalid query (0x00577218); test an_area_query_with_no_such_class_or_player_is_an_invalid_handle
GetRandomPointInArea: sampler 0x004d6d40, 20 attempts; FIXED -- box clamped to the map rectangle before drawing; test the_sampler_draws_only_over_the_part_of_an_area_on_the_map
MoveToArea ("move" into 0x0057a2e0): same body and fixes as AttackArea
AreaDistTo: circle edge distance or rectangle Chebyshev, clamped at 0; -1 on a miss
